name: @local/my-dsh-plugins
description: Umbrella bundle loader and configuration manager for local DSH plugins

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'), path = require('node:path'); fs.rmSync('index.js', { force: true }); fs.rmSync('client.js', { force: true }); for (const d of fs.readdirSync('.').filter(n => n.startsWith('dsh-'))) { fs.rmSync(path.join(d, 'index.js'), { force: true }); fs.rmSync(path.join(d, 'client.js'), { force: true }); }"
scripts.build: npm run build:plugins && npm run build:client && npm run build:self
